BiblicalUsage: The word names a deliverer, and Stephen uses it once, for Moses: the same Moses the people refused, saying who made you a ruler and a judge, God sent to be a ruler and a deliverer, by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God delights to send the very man a people rejected, and Moses the deliverer points to the greater Deliverer they would reject too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
